title: Competitive gaps from Hankweave comparison
description: As a Tactus maintainer, I want to close the gaps found in the Hankweave comparison (research/hankweave-vs-tactus.md), so that Tactus is clearly ahead for long-running production agent work. Definition of done: run spend budgets shipped, a coding-agent step available to procedures, a Why Tactus page published, and a release cut that no longer says alpha. Not included: copying Hankweave's fixed JSON plan model.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Source: research/hankweave-vs-tactus.md. Related prior art: tcts-1bfc71 (host-supplied budget authorization hooks, closed) covers host-side per-attempt authorization; this epic adds declarative in-language caps.
